name: Théo van Rysselberghe

summary.text: Théophile "Théo" van Rysselberghe was a Belgian Neo-Impressionist painter who played a pivotal role in the European art scene at the turn of the twentieth century.

2188296: Portrait of Marguerite van Mons is an oil-on-canvas painting by Belgian painter Théo van Rysselberghe. The girl portrayed is ten-year-old Marguerite van Mons, depicted shortly after the death of her mother.
15880868: Portrait of Irma Sèthe is an oil on canvas painting by the Belgian neo-impressionist painter Théo van Rysselberghe. The work is a portrait, painted in pointillist style, of the violin-playing Irma Sèthe, one of the heiresses of a musical family from Brussels with whom the painter was close.
17496122: Sailboats and Estuary is an oil-on-canvas painting by Belgian artist Théo van Rysselberghe. Painted around 1887, it shows a coastal landscape elaborated in a Pointillist technique.
21012032: The Lecture of Emile Verhaeren is an oil on canvas painting by Belgian painter Théo van Rysselberghe. Painted 1903, it is currently house at the Museum of Fine Arts in Ghent.
21620850: Maria Sèthe at the Harmonium is an oil-on-canvas painting by the Belgian neo-impressionist painter Théo van Rysselberghe. It depicts a woman with blonde, worn-up hair and a purple dress, seen in profile gazing toward the left.
66504211: Barques de pêche–Méditerranée is an oil-on-canvas painting by Belgian painter Théo van Rysselberghe. Painted in 1892, it depicts a fleet of sailboats off the southern coast of France.
99895637: L'Escaut en amont d'Anvers, le soir or An Evening is an oil on canvas painting by Belgian painter Théo van Rysselberghe.
L'Escaut en amont d'Anvers, le soir
99895967: Le canal en Flandre par temps triste is an oil on canvas painting by Belgian painter Théo van Rysselberghe, created in 1894.
